S1.3.why: core/ports/__init__.py returns the domain Order and the OrderModel-to-Order mapping (cents/100, status code to OrderStatus) lives only in adapters/prisma_orders.py.

S2.1.why: The 10000 threshold and VIP rule exist only in core/pricing.py price_order, which both adapters/rest.py and adapters/mcp.py call.

S2.2.why: tests/test_mcp.py asserts discounted totals (9000 and 8500 for the 10% and VIP rules), so it tests the business arithmetic, not only translation and error mapping.

S3.2.why: adapters/rest_refunds.py only builds the command, calls request_refund and maps reasons and statuses to HTTP codes; the window, amount and threshold comparisons are in core/refunds.py.
